key_difference: (D) keeps GenerationalCollatorHolder as a wrapper around a value-based QThreadStorage member with a forwarding localData(), where (B) inherits from QThreadStorage<GenerationalCollator> and re-exports localData via a using-declaration; (D)'s QThreadStorageData::clear() also skips set(nullptr) when the thread's tls slot is absent or empty, which avoids growing the tls list.
